name: Karim Fofana
title: Chief Operating Officer
note: Capacity LLC's own team page and its press page (indexed about 9 months ago) both list Karim Fofana as Chief Operating Officer.
raw:
Yes. Karim Fofana is currently Chief Operating Officer at Capacity LLC.

- **Company team page:** Capacity's own team page lists 
Karim Fofana as Chief Operating Officer. It says Karim is the COO at Capacity and has worked in operations and logistics for more than twenty years
. Under the rules, the company's current team page is enough on its own.
- **Company press page:** Capacity's press page, indexed about 9 months ago, also lists him in the executive team as 
Karim Fofana. Chief Operating Officer.

- **Third-party profile:** ZoomInfo backs this up. It says he 
is the Chief Operating Officer at Capacity LLC, a freight and logistics services company.


I found nothing saying he has left or changed roles.
